case.title: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
case.briefing: The new PX pump series needs shaft SH-220 (1.4021). Two suppliers quote: a German job shop and a Polish machining company. Lead time must not exceed 42 days; the line needs parts within 35 days, every day later costs EUR 150. Machined shafts are a leverage category: several capable suppliers, the goal is the lowest total cost. Award one.

messages.subject: Quote from Demo Drehteile GmbH: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
messages.body:
Hallo,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We can offer you a price of €17.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 28 days.

As a small shop, we like to keep things practical and clear for our customers. Everything is set up on our end to run your parts efficiently, and we look forward to working together on this order.

Let us know if this works for you so we can get started.

Gruß
Claudia Aigner
Owner, Demo Drehteile GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Drehteile GmbH: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
messages.body:
Hello Ms. Aigner,

Thank you for your clear and prompt offer. We appreciate the practical way you work.

We have to compare carefully, and this is where we stand:

Another supplier has offered EUR 16.00 for this part (offer:DEMO-C1-0).

To make a decision between suppliers straightforward, we have prepared a few genuine options. Option C offers faster payment, while Options A and B give you longer payment terms.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 13.38; payment 45 days net; lead time 28 days; Incoterm EXW.
Option B: unit price EUR 13.58; payment 45 days net; lead time 28 days; Incoterm FCA.
Option C: unit price EUR 13.29; payment 14 days net; lead time 28 days; Incoterm EXW.

We would be glad to work with you if one of these fits.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Drehteile GmbH: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
messages.body:
Hallo,

Hallo, thanks for laying out the options so clearly. We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. Cash is always tight for a small shop, so the 14 days payment in Option C works best for us. I can do €15.00 for that, which beats your other guy and is a solid step from our side. We need to clarify this internally - we will come back to you on price.

Our current offer is a price of €15.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 28 days, delivery EXW.

Gruß
Claudia Aigner
Owner, Demo Drehteile GmbH

messages.body:
Hallo,

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. 

Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net, and our Lieferzeit is 28 days. We have free capacity for your parts. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. Option B with the 14 days payment is exactly what we need to keep cash flowing.
